name: Unwelcome Guests
summary: You helped someone survive an encounter with unwelcome guests, and they are grateful. What brought you together remains unclear.

faq.answer: You helped the speaker survive an encounter, though they give no details about it.
The speaker who thanks you is not named.

faq.q: Why are they in my debt?
faq.answer: The speaker says you helped them survive, but does not explain what happened.
